title: Shorts you can take offline
body: Download native YouTube Shorts from the swipe feed and manage them in Settings. Offline mode plays completed downloads in the same feed. YouTube account actions are saved for reconnection, with review for uncertain comment sends. Downloads use Wi-Fi by default and respect Data Saver. TikTok and Reels still require a connection.

title: A fresh catch, every update
body: Clownfish now shows a clear summary of changes once after each update.

title: Yours to revisit
body: Reopen these release notes from Settings. They are bundled with this version and work offline.
